name: Flesheater
description:
55 Adaptive Force
500 Health


Hack the Meat
Dealing damage shreds 3 Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Applying stacks has a 1 second cooldown per Ability.

Cannibalize
On Champion Takedown, steal 10% of their stats and size for the rest of the round.
